The fix requires stripping the `<think>` content from assistant messages before making the API request:

2. **`camel/models/openai_compatible_model.py`** – Since the issue mentions "various model platforms support deepseek r1" (e.g., SiliconFlow, Together, etc. that expose DeepSeek R1 through OpenAI-compatible endpoints), the same `<think>`-stripping logic must be applied in this model backend's `run()` method.
